                    <div class="cooked"><p>Greetings Unity Community,</p>
<p>I would first like to personally thank Unity for allowing me the opportunity in showing off Football Strategy.</p>
<p>Football Strategy [FS] is a innovative football manager game currently in it’s early stages. [FS] is focus on being a challenging strategy game with in-depth game-play to offer the ultimate realistic simulation experience. We plan to offer many unique features and expand further based on the community feedback; which is why we urge you to register to follow our development and have open discussions using our in-game forum. For more information visit our official website at: <a href="http://footballstrategy.org" rel="noopener nofollow ugc" data-clicks="10" aria-label="http://footballstrategy.org link clicked 10 times">http://footballstrategy.org</a></p>

Football Strategy [FS] is a innovative football manager game currently in it’s early stages.
